product_type: Rear combination lamp: an exterior lighting and signalling module combining rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions with an outer lens and a retro-reflector in a single housing
summary: An LED-based rear combination lamp for M1 passenger cars. The specification lists five functions: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector and an outer lens that defines colour. The exploded-view drawing shows, from front to rear, the outer lens (with a distinct rectangular inset zone), a separate rectangular retro-reflector, a seal/gasket, a reflector with multiple optical cavities, an LED PCB with an LED array and other board elements, the housing with mounting holes, and three screw-type fasteners. The drawing callouts state target requirements: red lens within chromaticity limits, retro-reflectivity at 5° incidence, no water ingress after the spray test, rear position lamp 4-17 cd on axis, stop lamp 60-185 cd on axis, reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard, and aim retained under vibration. These are requirement targets, not measured results. Materials are representative only and must be confirmed against the bill of materials. Several points remain open and could change which regulations apply. These include the approval route (UN R148/R150 or legacy R7/R23/R3), the reversing lamp's white emitting zone given the red lens, the retro-reflector class and colour, whether the light sources are replaceable, the electronic content (EMC), and the mounting location.

components.name: Outer lens
components.function: Transmits light and defines its colour. Drawing callout: red, within the chromaticity limits. Spec material: PMMA, red-tinted, UV-stabilised (representative; confirm against BOM). The drawing also shows a distinct rectangular inset zone on the lens.

components.name: Retro-reflector
components.function: Passive conspicuity by reflecting incident light. Drawing callout: reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence. Spec material: PMMA moulded prism optics (representative). Drawn as a separate, non-triangular rectangular part behind the lens.

components.name: Seal / gasket
components.function: Environmental sealing between lens and housing. Drawing callout: no water ingress after the spray test. Spec material: TPE or silicone (representative).

components.name: Reflector
components.function: Optical reflector that shapes and directs LED light. Drawing callout links it to the rear position lamp (4 to 17 cd on axis). Spec material: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating (representative). Drawing shows an array of optical cavities plus at least two further separate compartments.

components.name: LED modules on PCB
components.function: Electrical light sources for the lamp functions. Drawing callout links them to the stop lamp (60 to 185 cd on axis). Drawing shows an LED array on the PCB, a striped rectangular element and a square element.

components.name: Housing
components.function: Structural enclosure and vehicle mounting body. Drawing callout: reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard. Spec material: PP or ASA/PC (representative). Drawing shows mounting holes at its corners.

components.name: Fasteners / clips
components.function: Fix the lamp to the vehicle and keep it aimed. Drawing callout: lamp stays aimed under vibration. Spec material: PA, POM or steel (representative). Three screw-type fasteners are drawn.

components.name: Rear position lamp (function)
components.function: Rear presence and visibility signalling. Drawing target: 4 to 17 cd on axis.

components.name: Stop lamp (function)
components.function: Braking indication. Drawing target: 60 to 185 cd on axis.

components.name: Reversing lamp (function)
components.function: Rearward illumination and signalling when reversing. Drawing target: visible to 45° outboard.

components.name: PCB electrical connector / interface
components.function: Electrical connection of the PCB to the vehicle. Inferred because the striped rectangular element on the PCB resembles a connector header; not labelled.

components.name: Secondary light source / compartment (possibly reversing lamp)
components.function: Inferred because a separate square element on the PCB and separate reflector compartments suggest a light source for a different function, possibly the reversing lamp. Not labelled.

components.name: LED driver / electronic control gear
components.function: Current regulation and possibly failure monitoring for the LEDs. Presence not stated or labelled. Relevant to EMC and electronic light source control gear requirements.

components.name: Vehicle wiring harness / connector
components.function: Vehicle-side electrical connection. Not shown or specified.

questions.question: Will the lamp be approved under UN R148 and R150, or under the legacy UN R7, R23 and R3?
questions.why_it_matters: It determines which regulation texts, approval marks and photometric or test requirements apply to each function.

questions.question: Does the outer lens have a colourless or white zone for the reversing lamp, given the lens is stated to be red?
questions.why_it_matters: Reversing lamps must emit white light. The answer determines the colour and photometric requirements for that function and whether the design can comply.

questions.question: What class and colour is the retro-reflector (e.g. red, Class IA or IB)?
questions.why_it_matters: Rear retro-reflectors must be red and non-triangular on motor vehicles. Class determines the photometric, durability and test requirements under R3/R150.

questions.question: Are the LED light sources non-replaceable (integral to the lamp) or replaceable LED light sources?
questions.why_it_matters: Replaceable light sources bring light-source regulation requirements (e.g. R128) and change the lamp's test and marking requirements.

questions.question: Does the PCB include LED drivers, electronic control gear or failure-monitoring electronics, and what supply voltage is used?
questions.why_it_matters: Electronic content triggers EMC requirements (UN R10). Failure detection affects installation requirements, and the voltage defines test conditions.

questions.question: Are the stop lamp and rear position lamp single-level or variable-intensity, and do they share LEDs or emitting surfaces?
questions.why_it_matters: This determines the device category (e.g. S1 vs S2, R1 vs R2), the intensity limits and ratios that apply, and whether the functions are reciprocally incorporated.

questions.question: Where exactly will the lamp be mounted: left/right, height, and on the fixed body or a movable tailgate or boot lid?
questions.why_it_matters: UN R48 installation requirements depend on this. They cover geometric visibility (e.g. the 45° reversing lamp angle), mounting height and lamps on movable components.

questions.question: Does the lamp wrap around the vehicle corner or integrate any other function (direction indicator, rear fog lamp, end-outline marker, side marker or side retro-reflector)?
questions.why_it_matters: Each additional function adds its own device and installation requirements.

questions.question: Is the lamp intended only for M1, or also for other categories such as N1?
questions.why_it_matters: Installation requirements and some device options differ by vehicle category.
